items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Xavier Cugat played, and there was no Roosevelt Hotel anymore where they had music with Guy Lombardo.

ctx.x: Yeah. In your eyes, what was the reason for that?

Probably, maybe because of the rock & roll coming in. Who knows? I remember a lot of places that the bands used to play in, Monk, were not around anymore. There was no music at the Waldorf Astoria anymore, where Benny Goodman played, Xavier Cugat played, and there was no Roosevelt Hotel anymore where they had music with Guy Lombardo. And there was no Paramount theater anymore where they had all the big bands. And there was no Strand Theater anymore, where they had the big bands. And there was no Capitol Theater…
Some of those fellas were able to find work in the studios in New York?
